approvedReuse.name: mineflayer
approvedReuse.notes: The modern client tick-end and interaction-sequence behavior is adapted as a temporary runtime compatibility shim for Mineflayer 4.37.1. SmartBotMC adds same-tick native-send detection, a shared signed sequence across placement/use/dig packets, the missing Minecraft 1.21.4+ player-loaded acknowledgement, and reversible teardown so a future upstream implementation is not duplicated. The adapted file retains an MIT modification notice.

approvedReuse.name: minecraft-agentic
approvedReuse.notes: The bounded coordinate-map canvas, compact primitive expansion, and focused translated tests adapt the approved concepts while adding strict schemas, version-aware registries, audit hashing, risk classification, and fail-closed limits. Every listed adaptation retains an MIT modification notice.

approvedReuse.name: cobble-mcp
approvedReuse.notes: The strict bounded palette and ASCII-layer expansion adapt the approved parsing concept while rejecting malformed art, omitting air/world changes, and routing cells through SmartBotMC's version-aware canvas compiler. The listed adaptation retains an MIT modification notice.

approvedReuse.name: mc-architect-mcp
approvedReuse.notes: The pure curved-wall, dome, and spiral geometry algorithms are adapted into bounded placement-cell emitters with typed placement hints. Fabric/server execution, FillOperation compression, and arbitrary block-state strings are excluded. The listed adaptation retains an MIT modification notice.

approvedReuse.name: ahmad-minecraft-mcp
approvedReuse.notes: The shipped villager Mineflayer action bodies adapt the approved interaction/social sources. Stable selectors, authorization, cancellation, verification, and focused tests are SmartBotMC-authored. Every listed public v0.1 adaptation retains an MIT modification notice.

approvedReuse.name: yuniko-minecraft-mcp
approvedReuse.notes: Coordinate placement/digging reach concepts are adapted in the verified executor. Both adapted TypeScript files retain Apache modification notices; snapshots, persistence contracts, and focused tests are SmartBotMC-authored.

approvedReuse.name: mc-multimodal-agent
approvedReuse.notes: The bounded ordered-step and meta-operation rejection guard, plus its focused translated test shape, adapt the approved execute_steps concepts. SmartBotMC adds a strict typed MissionScript schema, JSON-only data boundaries, BuildOps embedding, canonical hashing, and no tool execution or dry-run dispatch. Mission persistence types, storage, schema SQL, and durable task integration are SmartBotMC-authored. Each listed adaptation retains an Apache modification notice.
